objectives: Recognise final mb in taught words.
Identify /m/ as the final spoken sound in lamb, comb, and thumb.
Distinguish words with silent final b from words where b is pronounced.
Keep the silent b in conventional spelling.
concepts: In the taught words lamb, comb, and thumb, final b is silent.
The spelling retains b even though it is not pronounced.
The vowel and other sounds distinguish the words.

definitions.definition: A written letter that is not pronounced.
A consonant at the end of a word.
A speech sound that can distinguish one word from another.

workedExamples.solution: The word ends with /m/; b is silent.
They sound alike in many accents but use different spellings and meanings.
The final spoken sound is /m/, not /b/.

commonMistakes: Deleting b from spelling because it is silent.
Guessing without listening to the final sound.
keyTakeaways: Final b is silent in the taught mb words.
